source.chapter_title: Effects of Mesha and other signs being the Lagna

notes: Sloka 13: the description of a rising sign applies equally when the Moon occupies that sign, so each rule matches on either.

skipped.reason: Any exalted planet makes one a ruler: too broad to apply as stated (BPHS ch. 41 covers counts of exalted planets).
Retrograde planets act as exalted, vargottama as own sign: a weighting principle, not yet applied by the matcher.

rules.text: Aries rising (or the Moon in Aries): Round eyes, a fierce temper and quick movements; eats sparingly, is always on the go, changeable, prone to stretching the truth and to minor injuries; strong desires.
Taurus rising (or the Moon in Taurus): Sturdy thighs and a broad face; works the land; generous, forgiving and able to endure hardship; owns livestock; happier in the middle and later parts of life.
Gemini rising (or the Moon in Gemini): Dark eyes, curly hair and a prominent nose; playful and pleasure-loving, good at reading others' thoughts, fond of music and dance, and a home-lover.

Cancer rising (or the Moon in Cancer): Guided by the spouse, surrounded by friends and owns several houses; rich, short in stature, quick-walking, intelligent and fond of water, with few children; views can be crooked.
Leo rising (or the Moon in Leo): Reddish eyes, a broad face and large chin; proud, powerful, angered by trifles, drawn to forests and hills, firm-minded and obedient to the mother.
Virgo rising (or the Moon in Virgo): Sloping shoulders; gains standing through others' homes and wealth; truthful, kind-spoken and modest in look; knows the scriptures; few children.
Libra rising (or the Moon in Libra): A lean frame and tall stature; devout, a traveller, known by two names, clever in trade, brave, unsentimental and fair in argument; few children.
Scorpio rising (or the Moon in Scorpio): Rounded limbs and broad eyes and chest; separated from parents and teachers; can be harsh, yet is honoured by those in power.

Sagittarius rising (or the Moon in Sagittarius): A long face and neck with large ears and nose; short in stature, intent on work, favoured by authority, eloquent, generous, a match for opponents, won over only by kindness, and very strong.

Capricorn rising (or the Moon in Capricorn): Weak in the lower limbs but very courageous; carries through what is undertaken; can be indolent, outwardly pious, unconventional in attachments and lacking in shame; fortunate and always on the move.

Aquarius rising (or the Moon in Aquarius): A rounded, pot-like build; given to wrongdoing in secret and capable of violence; endures long journeys; covetous and free with others' money; gains and losses alternate; fond of perfumes and flowers.
Pisces rising (or the Moon in Pisces): A well-proportioned, glowing body and very good eyes; fond of the spouse; earns through pearls and sea produce; grateful, overcomes opponents and is fortunate.
